description: This file defines a mock class for the PersistentStoreImplementation, which implements multiple interfaces related to storage operations, notifications, and limitations. It uses Google Mock for creating mock methods for external dependency interactions.

classes.name: PersistentStoreImplementationMock
classes.description: A mock class that inherits from multiple storage-related interfaces, providing mock implementations of their methods for unit testing.

methods.name: ~PersistentStoreImplementationMock
methods.description: Destructor for the mock class, defaulted.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks registering a notification for IStore or IStore2.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks unregistering a notification for IStore or IStore2.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Mocks setting a value in the store, either with namespace/key or scope/ns/key depending on interface.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Mocks retrieving a value from the store.

methods.name: DeleteKey
methods.description: Mocks deleting a key, with scope variations.

methods.name: DeleteNamespace
methods.description: Mocks deleting a namespace, with scope variations.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Mocks retrieving all keys within a scope and namespace.

methods.name: GetNamespaces
methods.description: Mocks retrieving all namespace names within a scope.

methods.name: GetStorageSizes
methods.description: Mocks retrieving sizes of storage objects.

methods.name: GetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Mocks retrieving storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: SetNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Mocks setting storage limit for a namespace.
